mapper.insert: INSERT INTO MEAL_LOG (member_id, meal_date, meal, totcalorie) VALUES (#{memberId}, #{mealDate}, #{meal}, #{totCalorie})
mapper.select: SELECT id, member_id, meal_date, meal, totcalorie FROM MEAL_LOG WHERE member_id = #{memberId} ORDER BY meal_date DESC

SELECT ml.id, ml.member_id, ml.meal_date, ml.meal, ml.totcalorie FROM MEAL_LOG ml JOIN MEMBER m ON ml.member_id = m.id JOIN USER u ON m.user_id = u.id WHERE u.email = #{email} AND u.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY ml.meal_date DESC
